notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (reviewed_by stays null); no hardware was run and no hardware backend exists. The only backend factory is .fake:FakeRotaryInvertedPendulumEnv. gymnasium and mujoco were not importable where the gate ran, so fake.py is a pure Python reduced planar model of the upstream RotaryInvertedPendulumEnv, not the upstream MuJoCo environment; it was not compared with the upstream environment and trajectories can differ. The upstream environment, the MuJoCo model, the policy training stack and the physical rig were not run. A live upstream path would need gymnasium and mujoco plus the flat policy/ imports (the policy directory is not an installable package, policy/pyproject.toml:28-30); the physical rig's binary serial bridge is outside this sim-env card. The physics-timing declaration (1 ms timestep, 20-tick control decimation, the fake's data.time clock) is taken from policy/pendulum_env.py:343, :668-670 and :1008, and the fake advances that clock exactly. The fidelity contract is F1 and its gaps list the missing MuJoCo rigid-body arm/pendulum coupling, contacts, PD actuator, friction, firmware measurement and noise model, boxcar smoothing, transport lag and domain randomisation, the unexercised 135-degree hard-stop termination, the absence of wall-clock pacing, the lack of comparison with upstream, and the absent snapshot/restore. No driver Limit was invented: the only input bound is the upstream action-space Box, cited by action_space_ref at policy/pendulum_env.py:731-733; no bound is operator_required. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for the integer seed and ticks inputs and the simulator's numeric action.values; these are the Gymnasium family's documented warnings. Only catalogue cap.world.* classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. No deviation from the card. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review checked every fact and the copied action space, observation/reset contract, physics-tick accounting, source pin and licence. Corrected driver.py, facts.md and test_driver.py to declare F0 instead of F1 because the analytic fake has no rigid-body contact model, and marked its unsourced toy transition in fake.py. Split the episode-length calculation from the actual truncation predicate, corrected the complete reward-cost/return citations and disclosed the separate unserved serial rig path. Regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; the fake gate and strict collector pass, with contract_checked evidence only. For the human reviewer: R0 applies only to the fake simulation contract. policy/real_env.py:76 RealRotaryInvertedPendulumEnv and policy/lowlevel_client.py:87 serial I/O can drive the physical rig and are outside this package. The fake clamps its target at 125 degrees and cannot exercise the 135-degree hard-stop branch. Its sourced normalized action Box is not a physical motor-safety envelope; its analytic transition is not a validated Furuta model.
